# Offline renderer sources

Copied from the existing repository resources without modifications. These local assets avoid a CDN dependency in the MarginNote WebView.

- `marked.js` — source: `mnutils/mnutils/marked.js`; SHA-256: `fa99dbbf334ad1e9c31dadc7bb9b48f5ba2341a2036479077a62c10602c100d0`.
- `mathjax-tex-svg.js` — source: `mnutils/mnutils/latexEditor/mathjax-tex-svg.js`; SHA-256: `0b87a177df54aa14761e6437f9cabbcd10ace7561e1828d6e6aae94bbd8e1f36`.

marked retains its upstream MIT copyright header. MathJax is the existing bundled TeX-to-SVG distribution from MNUtils.
